high_level_description: This image is a meme featuring an illustration of a cat sitting in a box. The cat appears to be observing a setup involving a Geiger counter and a poison bottle with a skull and crossbones symbol. Illustration: The central figure is a brown cat with white markings on its chest and paws. The cat is sitting upright in a box, looking towards the right side of the image. Inside the box, there is a blue cube hanging from a lever, which is connected to a Geiger counter. The Geiger counter has a yellow radioactive symbol on it.
